title: Designing Successful Startups (Jothy Rosenberg) — Eric: 'If all the entrepreneurs in the world went on strike, it would be a disaster'
summary: Jothy Rosenberg — 9X founder, Tech Startup Toolkit author, Silicon Catalyst advisor — releases a launch-week conversation framing Incorruptible's deeper claim: founders are the structural foundation of the economy, and the system as currently designed is hollowing them out.
blockquote: We who create new companies are the foundation of our entire economic system. If all the entrepreneurs in the world went on strike, it would be a disaster.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Designing Successful Startups
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by Jothy Rosenberg, 9X founder
